items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: he offered Milt Senior enough money to take our band away from the Chateau de France

ctx.x: But then Martin came to Toledo and had dinner at this place, and on his way from New York to Chicago -- he was on his way to Chicago to open a new club called the Gold Coast Club, and he heard our little band in Toledo, and he fell in love, and he thought it'd be just the music he wanted in his new club, so he offered Milt Senior enough money to take our band away from the Chateau de France, and we came to Chicago to play at the new Gold Coast Club which was at 19 East Ceadar Street on the north side, an old…
